areas.assessment: Mostly placeholders and deliberately deferred. Recover original behavior from psz-re where possible, while separating deliberate new encounter design from fidelity work.
areas.next: Add Snowfield and Makara bosses; make Mother Brain the Arca Plant boss (including necessary level changes), Dark Falz the Dark Shrine boss with a richer form progression, and Blade/Force/Shot Mother Eternal Tower bosses rather than ordinary enemies. Resolve internal identity mappings before implementation. Playtest Reyburn HUD, dodge/pushback, recovery, projectile cleanup and return/retry handling; original attack/phase fidelity and the other boss assignments remain open. Grade and owner assessment unchanged; Mac playtest pending. Dark Shrine test encounters now have dedicated controllers, descriptor timing and phase-boundary probes; playtest Trinity piece/body exposure and Falz half/quarter reactions. Trinity now uses s07z_na1 with a fixed body in the broken platform edge, animated head receiver and head-origin laser; verify platform coverage and camera in the Mac playtest against reference #755. Trinity now has exclusive tile reservations, hop-spin-melee/tech cycles, synchronized waves, and an authored floor-cover break after two losses with the survivor retained. Verify combat balance and original cover identity; piece visuals, exact retail tactics/delivery geometry, selection, retail coordinates/handoff, and Reyburn/Octo full parity remain incomplete. Falz now walks, strikes forward, carries variable-radius balls, retracts them for radial volleys, telegraphs floor-tail strikes and enters a faster damageable shadow phase below quarter HP. Verify original effect assets and hands-on combat balance. Grades unchanged. Reyburn/Octo now have recovered sequence controllers; the Octo follow-up adds separate captured suction failure timelines, water-center spawn, joint receivers, spin/side relocation, ink poison and encounter presentation. Paru now has a dedicated split D Chaos/D Mobius encounter with shared HP and recovered timing; playtest independent attacks, shared damage, defeat and retry. Paru movement, targeting and projectile/status geometry remain incomplete. First Mac playtest found missing intro/victory presentation, a centered reticle and excessive HP. Follow-up adds control-gated camera shots, moving-part reticles and unmultiplied tier HP. Original-game comparison adds the original z_003u drill rig and o0c_bsef01 digging effect, hovering/burrowing attacks, dash approach, strafing and occasional follow-up shots; linked orbit retained. Verify these and fight duration on Mac; Zonde remains unconfirmed. Arca Humilias now has source65 stats/model identity, combined attack chains, HP-gated splits, paired return and spatial floor warnings. Playtest split/recombine, floor hazards, damage and retry on Mac; targeting/movement, status/projectile geometry and knockdown parity remain incomplete. Playtest these on Mac; successful swallow/escape, exact spatial/camera/combat parity remain open.

areas.assessment: Kion raises Systems from D to C after local Mac playtesting of PR #752 (6c2230c2 plus the playtest fixes committed in this PR) on 2026-10-11. Combat progression, inventory grinding with visible per-instance ATP and grind levels, dedicated Photon Blast activation and the segmented HUD gauge now support the core loop. The Coliseum exit blocker was reproduced and fixed with regression coverage; broader balance and fidelity work remain.
areas.next: Continue quest and free-roam playtesting after the Coliseum exit fix. Validate economy, class/EXP and enemy-level tuning, weapon specials/status fidelity, technique weapons and party Photon Blast behavior. Coliseum now exposes player/enemy levels, scaled HP previews and debug invincibility; verify hands-on tuning and controller use. Existing traversal defects remain separate follow-up work. Grade and assessment date unchanged.
